insights.one_liner: The oldest university in the Netherlands, with about 7,860 staff; its open research jobs don't need Dutch and draw many applicants.

culture.text: The oldest university in the Netherlands, founded in 1575 and based in Leiden.

open.text: International students from 75 countries began studies in Leiden this year.
Not listed under this name in the IND register as a recognised sponsor.

growth.text: Staff grew from about 5,500 in 2015 to 7,860 in 2024.

worth_knowing.text: Leiden University suffered a data breach.
Its Public Administration research was ranked among the world's best.
